# NEW 2026-11-22 v10.0 Worker 3: Playable Ming Dual-Track & Zheng He (oe_pmng_, Slot 79). Generated by gen_playable_ming.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Country scope. Dual-track Ming host: MNG directly, OR a Han Chinese dynasty holding Middle Kingdom
# when MNG does not exist. STRICTLY excludes Great Yuan (CHI/YUA) and Manchu (MCH) so human Yuan runs
# stay completely untouched.
oe_pmng_is_host = {
	is_rebel_country = no
	OR = {
		tag = MNG
		AND = {
			NOT = { country_exists = c:MNG }
			NOT = { tag = CHI }
			NOT = { tag = YUA }
			NOT = { tag = MCH }
			exists = international_organization:middle_kingdom
			is_leader_of_international_organization = international_organization:middle_kingdom
			culture ?= { has_culture_group = culture_group:chinese_group }
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. True if an Eastern Roman counterpart (BYZ or ROM) is alive for Ming-Roman Twin Phoenix diplomacy.
oe_pmng_has_roman_partner = {
	OR = {
		country_exists = c:BYZ
		country_exists = c:ROM
	}
}

# Country scope. True if Ming holds core Jiangnan or Northern capital for major dynastic milestones.
oe_pmng_holds_china_core = {
	OR = {
		owns = location:dadu
		owns = location:shangyuan
	}
}

# Country scope. True when granary networks & open maritime silver trade are ready to weather the 1644 crucible.
oe_pmng_salvation_ready = {
	OR = {
		has_variable = oe_dip2_granary_active_flag
		has_country_modifier = oe_eco_v97_grain_stabilized
		any_owned_location = {
			OR = {
				has_building = building_type:granary
				has_building = building_type:fortress_granary
			}
		}
	}
	trigger_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = oe_pmng_haijin_axis }
		var:oe_pmng_haijin_axis >= 10
	}
	trigger_else = { always = no }
}

# Country scope. True when facing Little Ice Age or Silver Price Revolution distress (vanilla or v12.5 oe_cri2_).
oe_pmng_in_late_ming_crisis = {
	OR = {
		is_situation_active = situation:little_ice_age
		has_active_disaster = disaster_type:oe_cri2_little_ice_age
		has_active_disaster = disaster_type:oe_cri2_silver_price_revolution
		stability < 10
	}
}

# Country scope. True when Dadu has fallen but Ming retains a major southern capital stronghold.
oe_pmng_southern_ming_eligible = {
	current_year >= 1450
	NOT = { owns = location:dadu }
	OR = {
		owns = location:shangyuan
		owns = location:guangzhou
		owns = location:panyu
		owns = location:minxian
	}
}
